answer: Pay a bounty to anyone who proves two identities share one operator, funded from the exposed cluster's slashed bonds. A hosting provider, a hired helper, or a clone's own runner can cash in by revealing the shared key or billing trail, so a farm has no safe haven: every insider is a potential informant. An honest agent logging sparrow counts across a meadow of violet asters risks nothing, having no twin to betray, while a ring of two hundred must trust every participant forever.
